name: Murder, She Wrote
description: An unassuming mystery writer turned sleuth uses her professional insight to help solve real-life homicide cases.

videos.title: The Murder of Sherlock Holmes
videos.overview: Former English teacher Jessica Fletcher travels to New York to celebrate the success of her debut novel, but when an unwanted guest is murdered at a costume party, she wishes she'd stayed home.

videos.title: Deadly Lady
videos.overview: After a terrible storm, Stephen Earl's four daughters tell Sheriff Tupper that their father died while they were out on the boat. Jessica is only midly intrigued; she finds Ralph, the older gentleman who has offered to work for food, much more intriguing, especially since it is obvious he comes from money. The womens' stories about what happened on the boat change constantly, but once Ralph is found dead and later found to be Stephen Earl, Jessica has to help Amos wage through the inconsistencies in the four Earl daughters storylines to determine who killed their father and why.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Jessica heads to San Francisco for the wedding of her niece, Victoria Brandon, only to learn that Victoria is having second thoughts because she suspects that her fiancé, Howard, is having an affair. Although Jessica and Victoria are relieved to learn that Howard isn't cheating but rather dressing up as a woman to perform at a nightclub, the relief is short lived when Howard is arrested for murdering his boss, Al Drake, who had been refusing to pay him. The police are convinced that Drake was shot during Freddy York's act, which doesn't leave a lot of time, but Jessica is determined to prove Howard's innocence.

videos.title: Hooray for Homicide
videos.overview: Jessica's first book, The Corpse Danced at Midnight, is being made into a major Hollywood motion picture, backed by producer Jerry Lydecker. Jessica is furious to see how her book is being butchered by Lydecker and his crew. She heads out to Hollywood to confront Lydecker, but things take a turn when Lydecker is found dead on stage. Jessica ends up being the prime suspect in the murder, but luckily the officer in charge of the investigation believes she's too smart to be the killer and sets her up to find the real murderer.

videos.title: It's a Dog's Life
videos.overview: While visiting her cousin at Langley Manor, a country estate in the South, a man dies during a fox-hunt under strange circumstances, and Jessica tries to find out what really happened.

videos.title: Lovers and Other Killers
videos.overview: While in Seattle lecturing at the university, Jessica is convinced that the young man she hired as her secretary is not a killer.

videos.title: Hit, Run and Homicide
videos.overview: Jessica helps a most unconventional neighbor who is accused of murdering his former partner with one of his inventions.

videos.title: We're Off to Kill the Wizard
videos.overview: Jessica is asked to help solve the "impossible" murder of a wealthy, and much disliked, amusement park owner.

videos.title: Death Takes a Curtain Call
videos.overview: While attending a special ballet performance, Jessica helps solve the backstage murder of a young dancer by a defecting ballerina.

videos.title: Death Casts a Spell
videos.overview: Jessica's deductive abilities are in demand when a flamboyant hypnotist turns up dead, behind locked doors, in front of an audience of journalists whom he had put into a trance.

videos.title: Capitol Offense
videos.overview: Jessica is assigned to fill the empty seat of a deceased congressman for a brief period of time and finds a great deal of political game-playing in Washington.

videos.title: Broadway Malady
videos.overview: Broadway legend Rita Bristol and her daughter star in a musical produced by her son, not knowing that murder is lurking in the wings.

videos.title: Murder to a Jazz Beat
videos.overview: While in New Orleans, Jessica must solve the mysterious murder of a famous musician who died while performing onstage.

videos.title: My Johnny Lies Over the Ocean
videos.overview: Jessica's niece is terrorized on a cruise intended to take her mind off her husband's recent death...or is he dead?

videos.title: Paint Me a Murder
videos.overview: The life of a famous artist is threatened on what would be otherwise an idyllic Mediterranean island.

videos.title: Tough Guys Don't Die
videos.overview: Jessica meets Harry McGraw and they figure out which one of three cases may contain the motive for the death of a private detective. One dates back 25 years.

videos.title: Sudden Death
videos.overview: Jessica suddenly must learn all about football when she inherits an interest in a professional team.

videos.title: Footnote to Murder
videos.overview: An unpublished manuscript is stolen and its author murdered during an awards convention.

videos.title: Murder Takes the Bus
videos.overview: Bus trips are not always as relaxing as they should be. In this case, one passenger had a one-way ticket.

videos.title: Armed Response
videos.overview: Over Jessica's protests, she is taken to a hospital after a minor accident in the airport.

videos.title: Murder at the Oasis
videos.overview: An unpopular show-business personality discovers that elaborate security systems are no guarantee of safety.

videos.title: Funeral at Fifty-Mile
videos.overview: A Wyoming rancher leaves all to an ill-fated stranger, to the disgust of his disinherited daughter.

videos.title: Widow, Weep for Me
videos.overview: Jessica's vacation at a Caribbean resort is not solely for pleasure, but to investigate a friend's murder.

videos.title: Joshua Peabody Died Here ... Possibly
videos.overview: Plans to build a new hotel in Cabot Cove are put on hold when diggers discover an old skeleton that had been buried deeply that many of the townspeople believe to be the remains of Joshua Peabody. Not everyone is thus inclined though, and many people believe it's just a random dead body. But when Jessica and Amos head back to the dig site, they find there's another body there! Jessica not only has to find out who killed Wheatley, she has to help an old friend when his past comes back to haunt him.

videos.title: Murder in the Afternoon
videos.overview: While filming a soap opera in which Mrs. Fletcher's niece plays a part, a 'pretend' victim is really dead.

videos.title: School for Scandal
videos.overview: When Jessica is offered an honorary degree from Crenshaw University, she has no idea she's about to become embroiled in a murder. After the boyfriend of (in)famous writer Daphne Clover is found murdered, Jessica agrees to assist the chief of police, who has never had a murder case before, find out who the killer is. She soon has more on her plate than she bargained for when first Daphne's mother confesses, then Daphne herself confesses. Jessica realises the two women are simply trying to protect each other, and begins to look at the faculty at the university.

videos.title: Sing a Song of Murder
videos.overview: When cousin Emma's life is threatened, she plays dead and Jessica is summoned to London as the heir to the estate.

videos.title: Reflections of the Mind
videos.overview: Jessica decides to pay a visit to her long-time friend Francesca, only to learn that Francesca, who is now married to a much younger man, is convinced that she is being haunted by the ghost of her first husband, Ross. When her new husband, Scott, turns up dead, the investigation reveals that he had been poisoned, and suspicion turns to Francesca. Jessica, however, is determined to prove that her friend did not commit the crime, and begins looking into the mysterious re-appearances of her dead husband.

videos.title: A Lady in the Lake
videos.overview: While spending time at a lake, Jessica sees what appears to be a struggle and a woman falling from a boat into the lake.

videos.title: Dead Heat
videos.overview: Jessica goes to the races to watch her niece ride the winning horse. Then the horse's owner is murdered after a dispute.

videos.title: Jessica Behind Bars
videos.overview: Doing public service, Jessica becomes a hostage in a prison riot caused by anger in the handling of the doctor's murder.

videos.title: Sticks and Stones
videos.overview: When a woman is electrocuted in her bathroom, Amos chuckles that even Jessica can't make a murder out of it. Michael Dugby: Parker Stevenson. Harry Pierce: John Astin. Frederich Hoffman: Paul Benedict. Adam Frobisher: Christopher Stone. Edna: Evelyn Keyes.

videos.title: Murder Digs Deep
videos.overview: An archaeological dig at the site of Coronado's City of Gold does not please everyone and a new corpse is dug up.

videos.title: Murder by Appointment Only
videos.overview: One of Jessica's former students is murdered and she takes a personal interest in the investigation.

videos.title: Trial by Error
videos.overview: It's a bad day for the jurors when Jessica is the foreperson of the jury hearing the case of a man claiming self-defense in the death of an enraged husband.

videos.title: Keep the Home Fries Burning
videos.overview: Jessica, Seth and Amos try out a new tourist-oriented restaurant, and murder interrupts their meal.

videos.title: Powder Keg
videos.overview: After their car breaks down after dinner with the governor, Jessica and her friend Ames Caufield find themselves in a small southern town just in time for local bad boy Ed Bonner to be found dead, and young Matt Burns, the son of a former student of Ames', ends up accused of the murder. At the behest of Linda Bonner, the victim's sister who happens to care deeply about the accused, Jessica takes a look into the murder, but hatred runs deep in this town and it's pure luck (and Andy Crane) that leads Jessica and Ames to the right answer.

videos.title: Murder in the Electric Cathedral
videos.overview: Jessica must find the murderer of her close friend whose will is in contention between family and a popular evangelist.

videos.title: One Good Bid Deserves a Murder
videos.overview: A red hot diary of a sex symbol is to be auctioned and some of the bidders are ready to shed blood.

videos.title: If A Body Meet A Body
videos.overview: Investigation of a claim that the deceased was murdered leads the police to discover that the wrong body is in the coffin.

videos.title: Christopher Bundy -- Died On Sunday
videos.overview: Jessica and Grady head to the home of publisher Christopher Bundy, whose publishing company owns the rights to Jessica's first short story. Jessica is quite upset, as Bundy's magazine is known for it's racy pictures of young women. While there, Jessica is pleased to run into an old acquaintance, Chester Harrison, and when Harrison is accused of murdering Christopher Bundy, Jessica vows to prove his innocence but runs into trouble when the family isn't interested in having their own skeletons dragged out of the closet.

videos.title: Menace, Anyone?
videos.overview: Who was the intended victim when a tennis star is blown up in his girl friend's car?

videos.title: The Perfect Foil
videos.overview: At the request of aunt Mildred, Jessica agrees to stop by New Orleans to check on cousin Cal while on her way to Houston. No sooner does Jessica get to New Orleans then she is tossed into a Mardi Gras party where the host ends up dead, and Cal is accused of the crime. While attempting to clear Cal's name and reputation, Jessica delves into the world of cheating poker players, cheating girlfriends and vengefilled police officers while trying to convince a local lieutenant that Cal is not capable of murder.

videos.title: If the Frame Fits
videos.overview: After Julia Marcus Granger is found murdered during what seems to have been an apparent art theft, suspicion turns to her husband Donald, who, as a result, also ends up being suspected in a recent rash of art thefts where there were no fatalities. Julia's sister Sabrina is convinced that Donald didn't do it and begs Jessica for help. While looking into Julia's murder, Jessica realises that she has two completely different criminals on her hands, and someone tampered with the scene of Julia's murder to make it look like something else.

videos.title: Death Stalks the Big Top (1)
videos.overview: Jessica's niece receives a gift from her grandfather---a man long thought dead---which leads Jessica (Angela Lansbury) to a circus beset by accidents and murder. Part 1 of two. Neil Fletcher: Jackie Cooper. Edgar Carmody: Martin Balsam. Brad Kaneally: Greg Evigan. Katie McCallum: Pamela Susan Shoop.

videos.title: Death Stalks the Big Top (2)
videos.overview: Conclusion. Despite her brother-in-law's confession, Jessica refuses to believe he killed the circus foreman. Neil Fletcher: Jackie Cooper. Preston Bartholomew: Alex Cord. Edgar Carmody: Martin Balsam. Brad Kaneally: Greg Evigan. Katie McCallum: Pamela Susan Shoop.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: A retired policeman decides to re-examine an old case he never solved in which Seth was a strong suspect.

videos.title: One White Rose for Death
videos.overview: Attending a concert in Washington, D.C., Jessica gets involved with two East German defectors and a murder.

videos.title: Corned Beef And Carnage
videos.overview: An adman handling the account of a fast-food chain is murdered and Jessica smells something funny.

videos.title: Dead Man's Gold
videos.overview: While diving for sunken treasure near Cabot Cove, a young woman is murdered.

videos.title: Magnum on Ice (II)
videos.overview:
Jessica offers to help Thomas Magnum, who has been accused of killing a hitman with an unknown target.

The crossover starts on Magnum, P.I. S07E09 Novel Connection (I).

videos.title: Deadline for Murder
videos.overview: A veteran reporter, who suffered a heart attack, says his best medicine would be the removal of his publisher who has turned a good paper into a yellow rag.

videos.title: Obituary for a Dead Anchor
videos.overview: Jessica reluctantly agrees to do an interview for an old friend, Paula Roman, but is surprised when Kevin Keats, a journalist who had been doing a series of stories on an art dealer who was really a drug dealer, shows up to do the interview, complete with cameras and crew. After Kevin is presumed dead when a boat Amos chartered for him explodes, Cabot Cove explodes with press and paparazzi, and the citizens blame Jessica for all the problems it causes, demanding that she solve the mystery. Unfortunately, once Keats is revealed to be alive and well, the real question is who the true target was.

videos.title: Stage Struck
videos.overview: The murder of the leading lady's understudy disrupts rehearsals of a play starring two previously married, but now warring, actors.

videos.title: Night of the Headless Horseman
videos.overview: The 'headless' horseman rides again, but his costume becomes more realistic.

videos.title: The Corpse Flew First Class
videos.overview: Theft and murder of the courier occur on board a jet bound for London.

videos.title: Crossed Up
videos.overview: The phone wires get crossed during a storm and Jessica can't convince anyone that what she heard was real.

videos.title: Murder in a Minor Key
videos.overview: Jessica tells the tale of a composer accused of killing the professor who plagiarized his music.

videos.title: The Bottom Line Is Murder
videos.overview: A lying TV Consumer advocate is killed. Was it done by one of the clients whose products he maligned?

videos.title: Death Takes a Dive
videos.overview: Jessica inherits a boxer's contract and her old friend; Harry McGraw is accused of murdering its former owner.

videos.title: Simon Says, Color Me Dead
videos.overview: An artist is murdered and his prized painting is missing.

videos.title: No Laughing Murder
videos.overview: After the engagement party for the offspring of two estranged comics, someone is found dead.

videos.title: No Accounting for Murder
videos.overview: Grady Fletcher is in big trouble when his boss, a specialist in tax shelters, is found dead and he is the main suspect.

videos.title: The Cemetery Vote
videos.overview: First, the reform mayor dies in an "accident" and then the mayor's father is murdered after he demands an investigation of the "accident".

videos.title: The Days Dwindle Down
videos.overview: Thirty years ago, Sam Wilson was sent to prison for murdering his boss, Malcolm Jarvis. After finally being released, Sam goes home to his wife and now-grown son who is expecting his first child with his wife, Terry. At Georgia Jarvis' request, Jessica looks into the crime, and through flashbacks, Sam remembers when Jarvis had offered him $10,000 to make his suicide look like murder. While Jessica believes that Sam is innocent, she doesn't believe it was suicide, and asks Sam's son Rod, a police officer, to lend a hand.

videos.title: Murder, She Spoke
videos.overview: During a short black-out in the studio where Jessica is recording a book for the blind, the studio co-owner is murdered.

videos.title: A Fashionable Way to Die
videos.overview: Ooh la la! Jessica travels to gay Paris to spend some time with an old friend... and finds herself entangled in a case involving fashion, finance and murder.

videos.title: When Thieves Fall Out
videos.overview: A walk down memory lane is anything but pleasant for Jessica when she re-examines a 20 year-old case involving her close friends and former students.

videos.title: Witness for the Defense
videos.overview: Jessica goes to Quebec to testify at the trial of a friend who is accused of killing his wife and burning his house.

videos.title: Old Habits Die Hard
videos.overview: A terminally ill nun seems to have committed suicide which would be an unacceptable sin.

videos.title: The Way To Dusty Death
videos.overview: After the 'accidental' death of a tycoon, his associates battle for position to succeed him.

videos.title: It Runs In The Family
videos.overview: Cousin Emma in London has a new problem when someone serves her lover poisoned herring.

videos.title: If It's Thursday, It Must Be Beverly
videos.overview: When Deputy Martin becomes a widower by murder, the investigation turns up some surprising activity.

videos.title: Steal Me a Story
videos.overview: The special effects used by a TV producer are a real bomb.

videos.title: Trouble in Eden
videos.overview: Hostility and other surprises await Jessica in a town where she's posing as her friend to investigate the rumoured murder of the friend's sister.

videos.title: Indian Giver
videos.overview: A resident of Cabot Cove threatens the Native American who claims to own the land, and later is found dead.

videos.title: Doom with a View
videos.overview: Grady gets into a spot again when he is found with the body of woman known from college days and now had been dating a frat brother who was married.

videos.title: Who Threw the Barbitals in Mrs. Fletcher's Chowder?
videos.overview: Somebody laced Mrs. Fletcher's chowder and Amos' brutish brother-in-law was in for the long sleep.

videos.title: Harbinger of Death
videos.overview: Jessica is thrilled to be visiting her niece Carrie and her husband Leonard, an astronomer dreaming of seeing a long-lost comet, but when Carrie's ex-boyfriend Drake Eaton is murdered in the home she's been staying in, Jessica has to prove not only her niece but also her husband innocent of murder.

videos.title: Curse of the Daanav
videos.overview: Seth's family is touched by an ancient curse attached to the history of a ruby.

videos.title: Mourning Among the Wisterias
videos.overview: Jessica visits her old friend Eugene McClendon, who soon stands accused of the murder of an old friend, Jonathan Keeler. While helping clear Eugene's name, Jessica learns that her friend believes he is dying, and is surprised when he asks her to marry him so that she can look after his affairs once he's gone. Jessica agrees, but only so that they can expose Jonathan's true killer.

videos.title: Murder Through the Looking Glass
videos.overview: Jessica gets herself into a mess of trouble after overhearing the dying words of a professional hitman. When she investigates the murder of Adam Cosgrove, she soon discovers that no one seems to want to admit he's missing, let alone dead. With the help of a prickly police sergeant and a priest who isn't quite what he seems, Jessica discovers that the man who was killed was in charge of leading a top-secret government mission to protect a foreign diplomat, and that someone in the safehouse has gone to the other side.

videos.title: A Very Good Year for Murder
videos.overview: The Gambini family gathers to celebrate the 75th birthday of the patriarch and a murder.

videos.title: Benedict Arnold Slipped Here
videos.overview: Someone wants the old historic house enough to kill for it and its supposed hidden treasure AND Jessica is executor of the late owner's will.

videos.title: Just Another Fish Story
videos.overview: Somebody put the maitre d' on ice. Jessica wonders if she has made a bad investment.

videos.title: Showdown in Saskatchewan
videos.overview: Arson is intended to remove the Rodeo doctor and his patient permanently.

videos.title: Deadpan
videos.overview: Two critics take opposite views of a play based on one of Jessica's novels, 'Mainly Murder'. One is suspected of the murder of the other.

videos.title: The Body Politic
videos.overview: The suicide of a campaign manager who is suspected of having an affair with a married woman excites the press.

videos.title: J.B. As in Jailbird
videos.overview: When Jessica is arrested for murder, secret agent Michael Haggerty and her nephew Grady conspire to keep her safely in jail while they seek the real killer.

videos.title: A Little Night Work
videos.overview: A senatorial hopeful is murdered and his wife's necklace stolen.

videos.title: Mr. Penroy's Vacation
videos.overview: The sisters used a new type of fertilizer to make their chrysanthemums best of show.

videos.title: Snow White, Blood Red
videos.overview: A blizzard interrupts a skiing vacation and traps everyone, including a killer.

videos.title: Coal Miner's Slaughter
videos.overview: The coal miner's daughter thinks the mine owner is responsible for her father's death and someone takes action.

videos.title: Wearing of the Green
videos.overview: A Fletcher novel is the entree to a legendary actress who is a hermit refusing to meet anyone. The occasion is the theft of a famous tiara.

videos.title: The Last Flight of the Dixie Damsel
videos.overview: The airplane her late husband bailed out of in 1952 has finally been found -- with a body inside.

videos.title: Prediction: Murder
videos.overview: A psychic's predictions have come true, convincing a rancher's daughter that the next one, a fatal fire, will happen.

videos.title: Something Borrowed, Someone Blue
videos.overview: Grady's wedding seems doomed when someone does in the persnickety housekeeper.

videos.title: Weave a Tangled Web
videos.overview: Things look bad when a married woman's keys are found by the body in a motel room and she can't explain why.

videos.title: The Search for Peter Kerry
videos.overview: A long missing heir turns up and trouble ensues.

videos.title: Smooth Operators
videos.overview: When a drunk is found dead in the alley, it raises a lot of questions. He was well dressed (but only one shoe) and had no id or money--a robbery or something else?

videos.title: Fire Burn, Cauldron Bubble
videos.overview: A very attractive young witch appears in Cabot Cove making some residents wonder if she really died a century or so ago.

videos.title: From Russia ... With Blood
videos.overview: A purse snatcher gets Jessica in big trouble in Moscow. What they found in her purse shouldn't have been there.

videos.title: Alma Murder
videos.overview: An old English professor is caught red-handed over a young girl's body and insists he did it, but a young man later confesses. Whodunit?

videos.title: Truck Stop
videos.overview: Walter tells his story by way of black and white flashbacks which makes an interesting change from the usual. He has made a tape of the events that ended with his murder and we see the events unfold.

videos.title: The Sins of Castle Cove
videos.overview: A red hot novel, written by a former Fletcher student, seems to expose the small town's secrets and inspires murder. Julie Adams, Gloria DeHaven, Kathryn Grayson and Ruth Roman appear again as the local gossips.

videos.title: Trevor Hudson's Legacy
videos.overview: A small town editor in Montana threatens to claim in public that he is the real author of a dead man's manuscript.

videos.title: Double Exposure
videos.overview: In a strange case, Jessica bumps into an old friend who is supposed to be dead. His widow insists he is dead and Jessica hires Harry McGraw to investigate.

videos.title: Three Strikes, You're Out
videos.overview: A surprised burglar is blamed for the death of the team's pre-game TV Host.

videos.title: Mirror, Mirror, On the Wall (1)
videos.overview: Eudora McVeigh, a rival mystery writer, arrives at Jessica's door with seemingly friendly intentions, but the discovery of a corpse and a web of deceit follows her to Cabot Cove leading Jessica to suspect the woman of ulterior and sinister motives.

videos.title: Mirror, Mirror, On the Wall (2)
videos.overview: After Seth is hospitalized and diagnosed as poisoned, with an apple Eudora gave Jessica, she still believes in her colleague's innocence. Sheriff Metzger discovers the murdered P.I. was following her husband, Hank Shipton, and found him adulterous with rich Victor Casper's wife, Lisa. Hank's son, Bobby, is beaten up by local Arnie on account of pool bet debts. Jessica ties up all the loose ends.

videos.title: Appointment in Athens
videos.overview: Jessica's old friend, Michael Hagarty, persuades her to play a part in his scheme to free a fellow agent from captivity.

videos.title: Seal of the Confessional
videos.overview: A parishioner's confession to a priest is confidential and nothing will make him break his oath.

videos.title: The Grand Old Lady
videos.overview: When a famous mystery writer dies, Jessica recalls a 1947 case that the writer was personally involved in.

videos.title: The Error of Her Ways
videos.overview: When the wife of a developer is accused of killing her husband and commits suicide, it leaves the whereabouts of his embezzled millions a mystery.

videos.title: Jack and Bill
videos.overview: A former athlete cares for a friend's dog and, after his friend is murdered, finds the dog is a target.

videos.title: Dead Letter
videos.overview: An unsent letter turns up in an old bureau bought at a rummage sale the same day arson occurs in a furniture store. Are these events connected?

videos.title: Night of the Tarantula
videos.overview: A voodoo curse of death caused by the marriage of a plantation heir to the wrong person, sets off a string of events in Jamaica.

videos.title: When the Fat Lady Sings
videos.overview: The backstage activities are more exciting than the opera as a famous tenor suffers a heart attack after a shooting.

videos.title: Test of Wills
videos.overview: A wealthy lumberman invites Jessica to his island retreat to discover which of his relatives is trying to kill him.

videos.title: Class Act
videos.overview: A homicide detective is farmed out to teach a class. His opening speech reduces his class to two. Together they work on a special 'closed' case as their term project.

videos.title: Town Father
videos.overview: The town gets a shock when bachelor Mayor Sam is confronted on the speaker's platform by a young woman claiming he is the father of her five children. Julie Adams, Gloria De Haven, Kathryn Grayson and Ruth Roman return as gossips Eve, Phyllis, Idal and Loretta.

videos.title: Goodbye Charlie
videos.overview: Three sets of people try to claim the body found on the railroad track--a nephew, a daughter and a wife. Jessica narrates this story.

videos.title: If the Shoe Fits
videos.overview: A single mother is accused of killing the landlord that is always harassing her.

videos.title: How To Make a Killing Without Really Trying
videos.overview: Jessica is trying to learn to invest, but this wasn't the best day for it.

videos.title: The Fixer-upper
videos.overview: Jessica's niece, who is a real estate broker, arrives at the mansion and finds a body instead of a buyer.

videos.title: The Big Show of 1965
videos.overview: Twenty five years after a show in which a stabbing occurred, the cast is reunited and a mystery woman reappears, seeming to accuse Barry.

videos.title: Murder: According to Maggie
videos.overview: The producer of a police drama investigates the murder of a programmer who differed with her.

videos.title: O'Malley's Luck
videos.overview: An Irish detective does not believe the death of a real estate mogul was suicide.

videos.title: Always a Thief
videos.overview: Insurance investigator Dennis Stanton, who uses his skills as an ex-thief to solve crimes, returns to investigate a theft and two murders.

videos.title: Shear Madness
videos.overview: Jessica's cousin is left waiting at the church when her fiancÃ©e is murdered in a similar fashion to a murder 15 years ago for which her brother was blamed.

videos.title: The Szechuan Dragon
videos.overview: Grady and his pregnant wife are tending Jessica's house in her absence when an old seaman is killed in her front room.

videos.title: The Sicilian Encounter
videos.overview: Michael Hagarty is involved in a case in Sicily which has many twists and turns including the Mafia.

videos.title: Trials & Tribulations
videos.overview: Jessica is blamed for the death of an escapee who was wrongly convicted.

videos.title: Deadly Misunderstanding
videos.overview: A young reporter is persuaded to help a typist alter the evidence and move her husband's body.

videos.title: See You in Court, Baby
videos.overview: Jessica introduces this story of a lawyer with many enemies who is the victim and Dennis who must investigate.

videos.title: Hannigan's Wake
videos.overview: A journalist died before finishing his book trying to show a man was unjustly convicted of murder 16 years ago. Jessica is asked to use his notes to finish his book.

videos.title: The Family Jewels
videos.overview: A wealthy woman's passion for jewellery, not always hers, and her involvement with the chauffeur might be connected

videos.title: A Body to Die For
videos.overview: Eve is appalled to find the body of a friend of the local gym owner in her bedroom, but at a loss to explain it.

videos.title: The Return of Preston Giles
videos.overview: This time it is the company controller that seems to have been the victim of the previously convicted publisher.

videos.title: The Great Twain Robbery
videos.overview: Proving a burnt Mark Twain manuscript is a fake is the reason for a book expert's murder.

videos.title: Ballad for a Blue Lady
videos.overview: Jimmy Dean plays a country-music star who's the victim in this story.

videos.title: Murder in F Sharp
videos.overview: Jessica plays a tape sent to her by Dennis. Bad luck follows a famous concert pianist as he burns his hands and then loses his wife.

videos.title: Family Doctor
videos.overview: In Boston, Jessica and Seth are captured by the angry son of one of Seth's patients who didn't survive.

videos.title: Suspicion of Murder
videos.overview: Dennis is suspected in the murder of the husband of an old flame with whom he has been spending some time.

videos.title: Moving Violation
videos.overview: An influential father cuts no ice with Sheriff Metzger.

videos.title: Who Killed J.B. Fletcher?
videos.overview: A snoopy fan in Texas impersonates Jessica when she starts investigating a potential dog show scandal and Jessica is reported dead.

videos.title: The Taxman Cometh
videos.overview: The owner of Edna's Pies near St. Louis, is accused of skimping on her IRS payments. She in turn blames her ex-husband who, consequently, is found murdered.

videos.title: From the Horse's Mouth
videos.overview: An argument over stud fees ends in murder.

videos.title: The Prodigal Father
